theatres.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
theatres.review: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in…
theatres.fullReview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.
theatres.take: Mostly good reviews — the performances and direction impressed, even if the pacing didn't.

theatres.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: The End of Evangelion
theatres.review: SEELE orders an all-out attack on NERV, aiming to destroy the Evas before Gendo can advance his own plans for the Human Instrumentality Project.
theatres.fullReview: SEELE orders an all-out attack on NERV, aiming to destroy the Evas before Gendo can advance his own plans for the Human Instrumentality Project. Shinji is pushed to the limits of his sanity as he is forced to decide the fate of humanity.
theatres.take: Mostly good reviews — the animation and second half impressed, even if the story didn't.

theatres.title: Aryabhatt Ka Zero

theatres.fullReview: A directionless young man from a middle-class family struggles to find his place in a world that has already written him off. As life tests his resilience, he embarks on a heartfelt journey of self-discovery, hope, and finding the courage to believe in himself.

theatres.title: Neon Genesis Evangelion: Death and Rebirth
theatres.review: Originally a collection of clips from the Neon Genesis Evangelion TV series, Death was created as a precursor to the re-worked ending of the series.

similar.title: Gurren Lagann the Movie: The Lights in the Sky Are Stars

theatres.fullReview: Originally a collection of clips from the Neon Genesis Evangelion TV series, Death was created as a precursor to the re-worked ending of the series. Rebirth was intended as that re-worked ending, but after production overruns Rebirth became only the first half of the first part of The End of Evangelion, with some minor differences.

theatres.fullReview: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.
theatres.take: Genuinely divisive — critics can't settle this one.

theatres.fullReview: Influenced by a sinister Cricket and created by Geppetto, Pinocchio launches a violent crusade to carve himself into a real boy like his brother James, one piece at a time.
theatres.take: Truly divisive — for every critic who bought in, one checked out.
theatres.hook: Premiered at the Brussels International Fantastic Film Festival.

ott.fullReview: Ted Lasso, an American football coach, moves to England when he's hired to manage a soccer team—despite having no experience. With cynical players and a doubtful town, will he get them to see the Ted Lasso Way?
ott.take: Near-universal acclaim, with the music singled out most often.

ott.title: Lioness

ott.fullReview: Cruz Manuelos, a rough-around-the-edges but passionate young Marine, is recruited to join the CIA's Lioness Engagement Team to help bring down a terrorist organization from within. Joe, the station chief of the Lioness program, is tasked with training, managing and leading her female undercover operatives.
ott.take: Critics can't agree — high marks for the performances and visuals, complaints about the story.
ott.takeCounter: Viewers beg to differ — audience scores run well above the critics' line.

ott.hook: The follow-up to ‘The Devil Wears Prada’.

ott.fullReview: A group of college friends' Thailand adventure turns deadly when they become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen runs low, past conflicts emerge in their desperate fight for survival.

ott.take: Broadly positive reviews, though the originality drew grumbles.
